limitations: Synthetic checked/annotated books; not full compiler throughput.
Operation wrappers and append operand lengths are an untimed attribution run; operand lengths do not measure copying inside V8.
Plain/joined timings use one warmed process with five alternating samples per size; sub-millisecond cases are noisy.
Fully consumed output is SHA256 over UTF-8 bytes after each emission; output equality is exact before timings as well.
Joined variant changes only disposable generated B1 j_defs; no production Bend source change.
Disposable JS WeakMap metadata scoped to one emission; no shared-kernel/Bend production change.
Only terms without Var and App anywhere can skip substitution; all other terms use the original implementation.
Rebuilding App beta-reduces even when the target variable is absent; that behavior remains mandatory.
Facts are recomputed in each timed emission; checking and annotation are outside emission timing.
Synthetic microbenchmarks, five alternating samples in one process, shared-host observations; no whole-compiler speedup claim.

decision: No production emitter/kernel change. Definition join is a null result; closed/App-free substitution facts are a causal synthetic result requiring a scoped Bend representation and realistic checked-book measurement before promotion.
signatureOverlayReview: Read-only review found no blocking semantic discrepancy in reverse nearest-name planning; preserve BookCache fallback and note eager planning before first error.
